sources.quote: Inherited from Old Ruthenian дꙋхове́нство (duxovénstvo), from Middle Polish duchowieństwo, a calque of German Geistlichkeit; possibly, later reborrowed from Russian духове́нство (duxovénstvo). By surface analysis, духо́вний (duxóvnyj) + -ство (-stvo).

sources.quote: Ізю́м (Izjúm) + -ський (-sʹkyj). Cognates with Belarusian ізю́мскі (izjúmski), Czech izjumský, Polish iziumski, Russian изю́мский (izjúmskij).
